content: Letter 35, to Shaykh al-Islām Khwāja Sayyid Muḥammad b. Khwāja Shaykh Kajujī (ca. 831-32/1428-29, Lahijan-Tabriz?), leading Sufi and shaykh al-islām of Tabriz: a letter of greeting reporting on the author's travel via Lahijan during the first ten days of Jumādā II and the help of one Ḥasan, who will give the sayyid the details on arrival; it ends with an inquiry after the sayyid's health, and a postscript greets his disciples and khanaqah residents in Tabriz and voices longing to be among them (TMN/M f. 122a, TMN/MS pp. 28-29, TMN/D pp. 205-6).
